tagline: Preview PDFs, Office files, images, and media inside Odoo without downloading
problem: Users must download attachments to see what is inside invoices, products, and documents.
solution: Preview supported files directly in Odoo with thumbnails, OCR search, Office HTML preview, PDF annotations, and a full-screen gallery viewer.
benefits: Instant PDF and image preview in forms
Search attachment text with OCR indexing
Preview Word, Excel, and PowerPoint in the browser

features.title: Thumbnail Cron
features.text: Background jobs generate stored thumbnails for images, PDF, and Office files.

features.title: OCR Search
features.text: Find attachments by text inside PDF, TXT, and Office documents.

features.title: Office Preview
features.text: Read DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX as HTML without an Office license.

features.title: PDF Annotations
features.text: Add page notes while previewing PDF files.

features.title: Gallery Viewer
features.text: Full-screen preview for PDF, image, video, audio, and text.

workflow: Upload attachments on any supported record
Cron jobs build thumbnails and OCR text
Preview Office files or PDFs in the V2 dialog
